data.content_ref: inline:Extend the grounded extension to a two-dimensional label: each node receives (status, rank), where status is accepted/refuted/suspended and rank is an ordinal from the longest chain of defeating warrants that the skeptical fixpoint traverses. Acceptance then requires both status and a rank bound preserved under reinstatement; refutation carries the rank of the attacking root. This preserves determinism and polynomial cost if ranks are capped by graph size, but the rank component may not be monotone, so the least fixed point must be computed as a lexicographic product and rank-tie breaking must be canonical or confluence can fail.
